available.quote: The board shall issue a license by credentials to an applicant who ... holds a current license to practice optometry in another state or territory of the United States or in a province of Canada that has licensure requirements that the board determines are equivalent to those established under this chapter

requirements.value: Applicant must be a graduate of a board-recognized optometry school; pass Alaska law exam; hold current equivalent license in another US state/territory or Canadian province; have previously passed the NBEO; have at least 3,120 hours of active clinical practice in the preceding 36 months; have no disciplinary history; and have received adequate pain management/opioid education (unless no DEA number).
requirements.quote: was engaged in the active licensed clinical practice of optometry in a state or territory of the United States or in a province of Canada for at least 3,120 hours during the 36 months preceding the date of application under this section

definition_quote.value: "optometry" means the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, or performance of preventive procedures related to diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human eyes or adjacent and associated structures, consistent with this chapter and regulations adopted by the board
definition_quote.quote: "optometry" means the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, or performance of preventive procedures related to diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human eyes or adjacent and associated structures, consistent with this chapter and regulations adopted by the board

value: prescription and use of pharmaceutical agents including controlled substances
removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye and its appendages
methods_authorized.quote: "optometry" means the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, or performance of preventive procedures related to diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human eyes or adjacent and associated structures

drug_authority.value: A licensee may prescribe and use a pharmaceutical agent, including a controlled substance, in the practice of optometry if the pharmaceutical agent is used in a manner consistent with standards adopted by the board in regulation.
drug_authority.quote: A licensee may prescribe and use a pharmaceutical agent, including a controlled substance, in the practice of optometry if the pharmaceutical agent is used in a manner consistent with standards adopted by the board in regulation.

surgery_prohibited.quote: A licensee may not perform ophthalmic surgery unless the procedure is (1) within the scope of the licensee's education and training from an accredited school of optometry; and (2) authorized by regulations adopted by the board.

surgery_definition.value: an invasive procedure in which human tissue is cut, ablated, or otherwise penetrated by incision, laser, or other means to treat diseases of the human eye, alter or correct refractive error, or alter or enhance cosmetic appearance; does not include removal of superficial foreign bodies
surgery_definition.quote: "ophthalmic surgery" means an invasive procedure in which human tissue is cut, ablated, or otherwise penetrated by incision, laser, or other means to treat diseases of the human eye, alter or correct refractive error, or alter or enhance cosmetic appearance; "ophthalmic surgery" does not include the procedure described under AS 08.72.273.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: A licensee may remove superficial foreign bodies from the eye and its appendages. This section is not intended to permit a licensee to perform invasive surgery.

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a four-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: a nontopical therapeutic pharmaceutical agent course of at least 23 hours approved by the board or an examination approved by the board on the treatment and management of ocular disease

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: shall have successfully completed (A) the written and practical portions of an examination on ocular pharmacology approved by the board ... (B) a nontopical therapeutic pharmaceutical agent course of at least 23 hours approved by the board ... (C) an optometry and nontopical therapeutic pharmaceutical agent injection course of at least seven hours approved by the board

dea_registration_required.quote: require that a licensee who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database under AS 17.30.200(n)
